regions.name: Buzi
regions.quote: This species as currently described has three discrete and geographically widely spaced populations that can be broadly divided into southern (the uMkhomazi, uMgeni, Tugela and the Inkomati river systems in South Africa), central (the Buzi and Pungwe river systems) and northern (Ruo River in Malawi) populations.
